text:
anya: quick heads-up from design review: a few mismatches between console labels and our doc titles + a small a11y problem in the help drawer. dropping points for triage.

jess: please bullet them, will push to docs board.

anya: bullets:
- UI label 'model alias' vs docs 'pinned model' -> confusing during rollouts
- in-product help varies: sometimes full guide, sometimes just CTA; inconsistent expectations
- toast CTAs land at top of long doc pages (no anchor, no context)
- help drawer: ESC sometimes no-op, and focus isn't returned to trigger

olivia: UX preference: inline help = 1-sentence summary + single CTA. If we need longer how-tos, open a modal labelled clearly as "Expanded docs" (so screen readers expect a heavy read).

kevin: on anchors/analytics: propose pattern: /docs/{slug}#{section-id}?utm_source=console&utm_medium=cta&utm_campaign=help. Also include a tiny payload in telemetry when a CTA is clicked: {page, section_id, cta}.

tom: engineering ask: docs add stable ids for quantization, rollouts, caching. we'll only link to those stable anchors.

jess: copy suggestions (short):
- inline CTA (modal): "Read more"
- external (new tab): "Open docs"
- error toast: "See troubleshooting steps" -> anchors to error section
Plus: prefer verbs in CTAs to map to intent.

docs-bot: creating RED-3610 to capture label mapping + anchor list. attaching template.

a11y-bot: accessibility checklist (short): role="dialog" + aria-modal="true" on drawer, set focus to first actionable element, ESC must call same close handler as the X button, restore visible focus outlines, add aria-labelledby. Add screenreader matrix for VoiceOver + NVDA.

anya: naming decision? do we pick 'Pinned model'?

jess: vote: canonical = "Pinned model". migration plan: console shows "Pinned model (alias: xyz)" where alias exists, SDK deprecate `model_alias` with clear migration note.

kevin: i'll implement telemetry and add e2e that asserts ESC closes drawer and focus returns to the help icon.

olivia: will add Figma frames for inline-summary + modal and annotate hover/focus states.

anya: OK action items: docs -> RED-3610 CSV + stable ids; UX -> figma spec; eng -> ESC e2e + telemetry; a11y -> SR test matrix. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
